verdicts.reason: A: the photo panel is letterboxed, with brown gaps above and below it but flush to the right edge, so it looks like it is floating. The headline still breaks awkwardly as 'on / repeat', though the left column sits centred and evenly spaced. B fixes the headline break ('Your coffee, / on repeat') and makes the bag larger, but the photo panel stops about 50px short of the bottom. That leaves a dead brown strip under the image which reads as a mistake, and the copy block sits slightly high, with the left column bottom-heavy in empty space.
